title: Add a supplier
text: A supplier is a business you buy stock from. Add them here before creating a purchase order.
steps: Open Sidebar > Suppliers.
Click Add Suppliers.
Type the supplier name. Contact details, email, and address are optional.
Set VAT if the supplier charges it, and note whether prices already include VAT.
Click Save. The supplier will appear in the supplier list when you create a purchase order.

title: See what you ordered and still owe a supplier
text: View Purchase Orders shows all orders for that supplier, including the balance and the total still unpaid.
steps: Open Sidebar > Suppliers.
Click the arrow at the end of the supplier row.
Choose View Purchase Orders.
Check the Unpaid Orders total and the balance for each order.
Click Record Payment on an order to log money you have paid.

title: See a supplier's products and stock
text: View Products shows every product linked to that supplier and how much stock is still available.
steps: Open Sidebar > Suppliers.
Click the arrow at the end of the supplier row, then View Products.
PO Stock is the stock left from their purchase orders. Other Stock came from a different source.
Click View on a row to trace where that stock came from.
Click Export to send the list to Excel.

title: Edit a supplier or stop buying from them
text: Set a supplier to Inactive when you no longer buy from them. Their old purchase orders stay in the system.
steps: Open Sidebar > Suppliers.
Double-click the row, or click the arrow at the end of the row and choose Edit.
Update the details, or change Status to Inactive.
Click Save.
Delete is only available for suppliers with no purchase orders. Otherwise, use Inactive.

title: Print or export the supplier list
text: Print & Export lets you print the supplier list or save it as a PDF or Excel file.
steps: Open Sidebar > Suppliers.
Use the search box first if you only want a specific group of suppliers.
Click Print & Export and choose Print, PDF, or Excel.

title: Supplier reports
text: Reporting includes three supplier reports: Supplier Payment Status, Items Purchased by Supplier, and Items Sold by Supplier.
steps: Open Sidebar > Reporting.
Type Supplier in the search box.
Payment Status shows which supplier balances are paid or unpaid.
Items Purchased shows what you bought from each supplier. Items Sold shows how their products sold.
Choose a report, set the date range, and click Generate Report.
